name: omnetpp-vscode
description: OMNeT++ ini files: highlighting, completion of options, NED parameters, submodules and statistics, diagnostics, and running and debugging configs

omnetppIni.diagnostics.unknownParameters.description: Warn about keys whose parameter does not exist in the NED modules they match (resolved from the network of the ini file).

omnetppIni.codeLens.enable.description: Show Run / Qtenv / Cluster above each section.

omnetppIni.omnetppRoot.description: OMNeT++ installation (OMNET_ROOT). Its opp_run provides the option documentation and the run counts, and it is exported to terminals and debug sessions. Empty: the OMNET_ROOT environment variable, or opp_run in the PATH.

omnetppIni.run.script.description: Optional project script that runs a config, relative to the workspace folder, called from it as: <script> [-r <runs>] [-Qt] <ini> <config>. Empty: run the simulation executable directly from the ini file's folder.

omnetppIni.run.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments for the simulation (or for the run script, if set).

omnetppIni.cluster.script.description: Optional script that launches configs on a cluster, relative to the workspace folder, called from it as: <script> [options] <user> <ini> <config>[,<config>...]. The Cluster button is shown only when it is set.

omnetppIni.cluster.extraArgs.description: Extra options for the cluster script.

omnetppIni.debug.debugger.description: Debugger extension: CodeLLDB (lldb), Microsoft C/C++ (cppdbg), or the first one installed (auto).

omnetppIni.debug.program.description: Debug executable, relative to the workspace folder. Empty: the debug build (_dbg) of the target of the project's .oppbuildspec (a shared library is run with opp_run_dbg -l), or <workspace folder name>_dbg.

omnetppIni.debug.buildCommand.description: Command (run from the workspace folder) that builds the debug executable, such as a project build script; ${mode} is replaced by debug and ${jobs} by omnetppIni.build.jobs. Empty: make -j<jobs> MODE=debug in the workspace folder if it has a Makefile, otherwise in each makemake folder of the project's .oppbuildspec, creating its Makefile with opp_makemake (and the options the IDE stored there) if it is missing.

omnetppIni.debug.userInterface.description: OMNeT++ user interface for debug sessions.

omnetppIni.debug.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments for the simulation in debug sessions (e.g. --cmdenv-express-mode=false).

omnetppIni.run.program.description: Simulation executable, relative to the workspace folder. Empty: the target of the makemake folder of the project's .oppbuildspec (an executable, or a shared library run with opp_run -l), or the executable opp_makemake builds in the workspace folder (named after it), otherwise opp_run.

enumDescriptions: When it has not been built, or a source file (.cc, .h, .msg…), build file or omnetppIni.build.watch folder changed since the last build
Only when it has not been built
Every time (make only rebuilds what changed, but checking takes a while in large projects)
omnetppIni.build.when.description: When Run, Qtenv and Debug build the simulation before launching it.

omnetppIni.build.jobs.description: Parallel jobs of the build (make -j), also ${jobs} in the build commands. 0: the number of CPUs minus one.

omnetppIni.build.watch.description: Folders of other libraries the project depends on (relative to the workspace folder, or absolute): a change in their sources or libraries also rebuilds the simulation.

omnetppIni.run.buildCommand.description: Command (run from the workspace folder) that builds the simulation, such as a project build script; ${mode} is replaced by release and ${jobs} by omnetppIni.build.jobs. Empty: make -j<jobs> MODE=release in the workspace folder if it has a Makefile, otherwise in each makemake folder of the project's .oppbuildspec, creating its Makefile with opp_makemake (and the options the IDE stored there) if it is missing.

omnetppIni.nedPath.description: NED path passed with -n (folders relative to the workspace folder, separated by ':'). Empty: the folders listed in the project's .nedfolders file, or the workspace folder.
